environment.description: AWS Lambda function (Python 3.11 runtime, 256MB memory, 900s timeout) invoked as a Task state within a Step Functions Standard workflow. The state machine accepts input from an API Gateway endpoint with no request validation template. Lambda runs with default execution role (AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole). No Lambda concurrency limits configured. Step Functions workflow has no TimeoutSeconds configured on the Task state. CloudWatch alarms exist but only for error rate, not duration.
